  • Method Details

    • shoot

      public void shoot()
      Increments the counter and checks if it has reached the threshold. If the counter exceeds the threshold, it creates a new projectile and resets the counter.

    • heal

      public void heal(int healValue)
      Heals the entity by the specified heal value.

      healValue - The amount of healing to be applied.

    • addToInventory

      public void addToInventory(Item item)
      Adds the specified item to the inventory. Instantly heal the player if it is a healing potion. Increase coins value in player inventory if it is a coin and player already has some. Add item to inventory otherwise (if its coins and player has none, or it is a key)
      Parameters:
      item - The item to be added to the inventory.

    • hasKey

      public boolean hasKey()
      Checks if the player has a key in their inventory.
      Returns:
      true if the player has a key, false otherwise.

    • removeKey

      public void removeKey()
      Removes a key from the player's inventory. If the player has a key in their inventory, it is removed. If the player does not have a key, nothing happens.

    • kill

      public void kill()

    • upgradeAD

      public void upgradeAD()
      Upgrades the player's attack damage. Increases the attack damage by 10. Decreases the player's coin value by 100.

    • upgradeAS

      public void upgradeAS()
      Upgrades the player's attack speed. Increases the attack damage by 0.25. Decreases the player's coin value by 100.

    • upgradeHP

      public void upgradeHP()
      Upgrades the player's maximum HP. Increases the attack damage by 50. Decreases the player's coin value by 100.

    • upgradeMS

      public void upgradeMS()
      Upgrades the player's maximum movement speed. Increases the attack damage by 0.01. Decreases the player's coin value by 100.
